title: How to Choose a Safari Operator
excerpt: How do you choose a reliable safari operator in Tanzania? Points to compare beyond price.
body:
## Licences

Operators in Tanzania must be licensed by the tourism authorities. Ask for the licence.

## Reviews

Read reviews on several platforms, with dates. Be cautious of reviews without context.

## Guides

Ask about guide training and experience. See [how safari guides are trained](/blog/safari-guide-training/).

## Vehicles

Window seats, a pop-up roof and good maintenance. See [safari vehicles](/blog/safari-vehicles-explained/).

## Price

Compare what is included. Very cheap offers often save on guides, vehicles or park fees.

## Responsibility

How does the company treat staff and the environment? See [responsible tips](/blog/responsible-safari-tips/).

## Communication

Do you get clear answers quickly?

## Our questions

See [ten questions to ask](/blog/questions-to-ask-safari-company/). [Ask us anything](/travel-proposal/).
